description: Ministry of Labour - Notifications of the Wages Boards under the Wages Board Ordinance, for Tea Export Trade, Rubber Export Trade, Cinema Trade, Coconut Growing Trade, Ceramic Products manufacturing trade and Biscuit & Confectionary manufacturing trade
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the Wages Boards Ordinance and proposes variations to wage regulations for the tea and rubber export trades. It constitutes a regulatory matter under existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette (Type 5) rather than a government personnel/structure matter or other specialized category.
